scope: Five complete closed HTTP trees; host/numerical receipts; history fixtures; filtered host build; three offline execution receipt directories; fixed phase top-level artifacts; named tested build identities; direct verified external/source file bindings.
excluded: Mutable CONTINUE/report-draft, staging, whole source/export/build/model/reference trees, excluded regenerable objects, manifest itself and later packaging/commit/push receipts.
model_reference_limit: No model payload or reference-tree scan. Model content hashes are prior bindings only; final protection is metadata-scoped; reference whole-tree unchanged remains unknown.
failure_preservation: First failed offline protection attempt, v2 repair and successful second attempt are retained. Unexecuted conditional D/next preparations are explicitly labeled.
availability: All indexed non-model files existed and SHA matched their stated bindings when indexed. Local path and digest do not supply, restore or back up raw bytes; missing local data must be reported missing.
final_package_manifest: Not generated here; root binds this index and final documents after documentation is finished.
snapshot_scope: Closed evidence and named fixed top-level files at inventory creation only; later derived/report/delivery/closure/push receipts are excluded and may be bound by the final package manifest. Not an inventory of all future phase-root files.
